methodNote: Stage 6 resolves the entire remaining downloaded-image queue. Only visually clear square/squarish cash forms or deliberately included cash-derived pseudo-aperture forms enter the main corpus. Circular-hole, openwork/special-aperture, solid regional and non-coin/pseudo-money records remain source-preserved as related evidence.

families.title: Uncertain Central Asian square-hole cash
families.dateLabel: Broad pre-Islamic / early Islamic context; exact dates unresolved
families.description: A bounded group of visually clear square-hole cash-like AE records filed by Zeno under “Types under investigation” and an unknown principality. Their region/issuer labels vary across individual source records, so the editorial family remains deliberately unattributed.
families.question: Resolve issuer, region and cross-catalogue identities specimen by specimen.

families.title: “Nwr-pry” square-hole cash
families.description: Three Zeno AE cash records grouped under the reading “Nwr-pry”, all with clear square central apertures. The reading and polity attribution remain source claims.
families.question: Confirm legend reading, issuer and regional attribution in specialist literature.

families.title: Unattributed Semirechye square-hole cash
families.dateLabel: Broad Semirechye context; exact chronology varies by record
families.description: Square-hole/cash-like AE records filed directly under the Semirechye root rather than a stable ruler branch. Individual source titles include unknown qaghan, Türgesh, two-tamgha and unpublished forms; the family is intentionally provisional.
families.question: Split into stable ruler/tamgha families only after direct catalogue crosswalk.

families.title: Ferghana/Chach anepigraphic square-hole cash
families.zh: 费尔干纳／石国未署名方孔钱
families.description: Two uninscribed AE records in a Zeno “Ferghana?” cash group are described in individual titles as Chach-area issues and show clear square/squarish central apertures. Competing regional labels are preserved.
families.question: Do not resolve Ferghana versus Chach until specialist catalogues or find-context evidence are cross-checked.
